Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Dharwad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Audit Consultant position at IIT Dharwad?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Audit Consultant position at IIT Dharwad is 07 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Audit Consultant role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university, along with at least 10 years of experience in Finance & Accounts/Audit matters, with 5 years on Pay Level-8 or equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Audit Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Audit Consultant position is 65 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Dharwad Audit Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of IIT Dharwad or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Audit Consultant post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Audit Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Test, Presentation, and Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at IIT Dharwad.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Dharwad located?
faq.answer: IIT Dharwad is located in Dharwad, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is IITDh/Admin/SR/49/2026-27.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary offered for the Audit Consultant position?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per Ministry of Finance OMs or 50% of the last basic pay.
